shellCommands.command: for f in index.html src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; do echo "=== $f"; cat $f; done; ls __agent_eval__; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit && grep -o "export {[^}]*}" build/esm/index.d.ts | head; ls build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; echo; grep -n "variant\|TEXT_VARIANTS" build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head; grep -rn "display-\|header-" build/esm/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -3; sed -n 1,60p build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | grep -n "view\|size\|href"

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && ls layout; cat layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | grep -n "gap\|direction\|wrap\|justify\|alignItems" | head; grep -n "view\|type\b" Card/Card.d.ts | head; grep -n "color" Text/Text.d.ts | head -3
ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer"; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null; echo "---"; rm -rf dist
